name: Front raise
summary: Dumbbells in front of the thighs, raise the straight arms forward to shoulder height, lower slowly.
setup: Stand side-on to the phone, dumbbells in front of the thighs. Raise both arms forward, elbows nearly straight, until level with the shoulders, then lower slowly.
brief: Stand with the dumbbells in front of the thighs. Raise both arms forward, elbows nearly straight, until level with the shoulders, then lower slowly.
why: From the side the arms swing from hanging to horizontal each rep, so reps are counted.

show.ask: arms straight out in front, level with your shoulders, nothing in your hands

faults.label: Not reaching the target
faults.tip: Take each rep through the full range you set — half reps count as partials.

faults.label: Too fast
faults.tip: Control both directions; momentum takes the work away from the muscle.

faults.label: Leaning back
faults.tip: Leaning back cheats the lift; brace and stay upright.

faults.label: Leaning back to lift
faults.tip: Rocking backwards uses the lower back to throw the weight up.

faults.label: Swinging the weights
faults.tip: Lower the weight rather than swing it.

faults.label: Going far above shoulder height
faults.tip: Above the shoulder the trapezius takes over.

guide.cannotSee: The shoulders shrugging — a front-view detail.

points.t: Rise to shoulder height, nearly straight.
